title: 5 Tips for a Healthy Heart
excerpt: Maintaining a healthy heart is crucial for overall well-being. Discover five practical tips you can incorporate into your daily routine to improve your cardiovascular health.

children.text: A healthy heart is the cornerstone of a healthy life. Here are five essential tips to keep your heart in top shape: 1. Eat a balanced diet. 2. Exercise regularly. 3. Manage stress. 4. Get enough sleep. 5. Don't smoke.

title: Understanding Diabetes and Its Management
excerpt: Diabetes is a chronic condition that affects millions. Learn about the types of diabetes, their symptoms, and effective management strategies.

children.text: Managing diabetes effectively involves a combination of lifestyle changes and medical treatment. Regular monitoring of blood sugar levels is key.

title: The Importance of a Balanced Diet
excerpt: A balanced diet is essential for good health and well-being. This article explores the key components of a healthy diet and how to incorporate them into your meals.

children.text: Your diet is a bank account. Good food choices are good investments. Learn how to invest in your health through proper nutrition.

title: Frequently Asked Questions
subtitle: Find answers to common questions about our services, bookings, and what to expect during a consultation.

faqs.question: How do I book an appointment?
faqs.answer: You can book an appointment directly through our website by clicking the 'Book Now' button. Choose your preferred consultation type (Chat, Video, or In-Clinic) and select an available time slot.

faqs.question: What are the consultation fees?
faqs.answer: Our fees are ₹200 for a chat consultation, ₹500 for a video call, and ₹300 for an in-clinic visit. You can see a detailed breakdown on our Pricing page.

faqs.question: Can I get a prescription online?
faqs.answer: Yes, digital prescriptions are provided for all consultation types. For minor ailments, a prescription can be issued via chat. For more detailed consultations, a video call or in-clinic visit is recommended.

faqs.question: What should I do in case of an emergency?
faqs.answer: This service is not for medical emergencies. In case of a medical emergency, please visit your nearest hospital or call emergency services immediately.
